name: Josephine Petrillo

residences.place: 1003 Bunker Hill Street, Scranton Ward 10, Pennsylvania, USA
residences.note: Wife (35) of Nicholas Castellano, railroad car repairer; children Vito 15, Carmella 14, Marie 11.

bioAdditions: Josephine Castellano died in Phoenix on 28 November 1995, aged 91. Her obituary in The Arizona Republic says she was born in Scranton and was a homemaker. She was survived by daughters Carmella Valvano and Marie Liburdi, son Vito, brothers Nick, Jim and Rocco Petrillo, nine grandchildren and 15 great-grandchildren. Visitation was at Whitney and Murphy Arcadia Funeral Chapel, with Mass at St. Theresa Catholic Church, Phoenix (S1). In 1940 she and her husband Nicholas Castellano, a railroad car repairer, lived at 1003 Bunker Hill Street, a few doors from her parents' old home, with Vito, Carmella and Marie (S2). She is probably the 'Joseph, 5' of the 1910 census (see H0354) (S3).
